comments.value: I've been having this problem too, I tested it and I can't even see notifications on the website when I ask for an invite, I've literally been completely locked out of private worlds for weeks now.
Still have the problem, it's legit been a month now...

Allot of clients have either gotten their issue resolved or remain unchanged, whatever is causing the notification system to not generally work is really confusing. I would actually get a notification pop up of someone adding me or asking me to join the world I'm in, but that would be only like once and I would never get any kind of notification again. The notification system definitely either needs to have a big fix or it just needs to be remade in general. It may or may not be the case that the move to the new Unity version has broken some things about the game, but whatever has broken the notification system was done about maybe two months ago at this moment.

i have been experiencing this issue for over a month now.
still experiencing it. (the first time it happened was a few days after the Cloudflare thing happened)
I am also experiencing this problem. I have probably had it for like 1 month now or 2. I was able to get a Request yesterday but it has come back now. 30-05-2019 00:04 AM
Im not getting invites at all, even after deliberate testing with friends =Quest User

Can confirm, notifications stop being visible after you spend some time in VRChat for some reason. This issue is highly inconvenient, especially for those who got VRC+ just to send images along with invite/request messages...
The problem has still not been fixed and needs to be deal with either finding a permanent bug fix for it or just redoing the whole notification system

details:
It seems like almost every day now I have this issue.
Process goes like this:

1> Send invite request to invite+ world
2> Friend receives request and accepts it
3> Invite Notification never reappears on my side

This happens sporadically throughout the day and I can never really judge when it will happen.

An example of this can be shown from the timestamp 1h16m to 1h21m here: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/397038291?t=01h16m03s
title: Invite Request notifications do not show up
